entry.title: GPT-6 Astra constructs mutually orthogonal Latin squares that improve lower bounds at 33 orders
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra produced explicit mutually orthogonal Latin-square constructions that improve known lower bounds for N(n) at 33 values of n from 22 through 494. The standout construction gives four MOLS of order 22, completing the last open case needed to show N(n)≥4 for every n>10. The same paper… (Discovery - Christopher D. Rosin (Constructive Codes; independent research project); announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: t-SNE-selected LMC radio source receives a spectroscopic AGN classification at z = 2.80
entry.summary: SALT spectroscopy of the previously unclassified source LMC tSNE b8 (R.A. 06:22:41.86, Dec. −68:59:21.9) identified it as an active galactic nucleus at redshift z = 2.80. The source was selected from the blazar-like sequence in a t-SNE map combining VISTA near-infrared and ASKAP radio survey data… (Discovery - Keele University; Southern African Large Telescope collaboration; collaborators; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Cockpit public-key helper could follow home-directory symlinks during privileged ownership changes
entry.summary: A local authenticated user who can control a target account home directory can exploit Cockpit’s privileged Add Public Key helper. Symlinks in .ssh or authorized_keys paths could redirect privileged ownership/mode operations to other files, allowing local privilege escalation or unauthorized file… (Vulnerability - AISLE in partnership with Red Hat; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: TriSCOPE links cell-type-specific Alzheimer’s expression programs to inherited risk loci
entry.summary: TriSCOPE combined cell-level predictive modeling, donor-aware differential expression and pseudotime analysis across six single-nucleus RNA-sequencing datasets (about 4.2 million nuclei from 627 donors). It identified cell-type-specific predictively expressed genes that were often missed by… (Discovery - Harvard Medical School; Harvard College; New York Genome Center; Rush Alzheimer’s Disease Center, Rush University; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg MJPEG decoder use-after-free
entry.summary: A stale image-buffer pointer in hardware-accelerated MJPEG decoding can be read after a malformed SOF marker without a preceding SOI, leading to a crash or possible heap-data exposure. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg VP9 parser integer overflow
entry.summary: On 32-bit builds, forged VP9 superframe sizes can overflow the size check in `cbs_vp9_split_fragment()` and cause an out-of-bounds read. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg VAAPI decoder memory leak
entry.summary: Error paths after slice parse failures leave VAAPI picture and slice buffers allocated, enabling repeated malformed frames to exhaust memory. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg Vulkan FFV1 encoder integer overflow
entry.summary: An integer overflow can undersize the Vulkan encoder’s float-remap buffer for large frames, permitting out-of-bounds GPU-memory writes during transcoding. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg FLIC decoder heap buffer overflow
entry.summary: A one-sided pixel-bound check allows negative-stride FLIC frames to write beyond frame storage in `check_pixel_ptr()`, corrupting heap memory. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg AV1 frame-merge memory exhaustion
entry.summary: The AV1 frame-merge filter buffers temporal units without a bound when no temporal delimiter OBU arrives, allowing a crafted stream to exhaust memory. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg Vulkan AV1 tile-count heap overflow
entry.summary: A heap out-of-bounds write in `vk_av1_decode_slice()` occurs when an AV1 stream exceeds the tile count and the decoder writes past `tile_sizes`. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg EXIF parser memory exhaustion
entry.summary: Overlapping EXIF payload references can cause quadratic allocation in `libavcodec/exif.c`, exhausting memory while an application decodes a crafted image. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg MLZ decoder uninitialized-memory disclosure
entry.summary: Out-of-range MLZ dictionary codes can copy uninitialized heap bytes into decoded audio output from a crafted MPEG-4 ALS file. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: FFmpeg Bink decoder NULL dereference
entry.summary: The Bink decoder ignores a failed bit-reader initialization for an oversized frame, leading to a NULL-pointer dereference and process crash. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: PCFNet-guided spectroscopy confirms four protoclusters at redshift 3.3–3.4
entry.summary: Subaru/MOIRCS spectroscopy of four PCFNet-selected candidate regions confirmed four protoclusters at z = 3.316, 3.403, 3.408 and 3.425, across three regions, with galaxy-density peaks more than five times the uniform distribution. Twenty-three spectroscopically identified members are largely on… (Discovery - The University of Tokyo; National Astronomical Observatory of Japan; Tohoku University; Subaru Telescope; announced 2026-11-06)
